## Approval gate
- [ ] Draft PR; no merge performed.
- [ ] No unapproved model fitting, tuning, live data, paid service, betting action, or deployment.
- [ ] Files for review are readable in this PR; ZIP optional, never required.

> The PR is a proposal, not authorization. Only report tests actually executed; no implied predictive validity or performance.
